name: IDPH Home Services Placement Agency Directory

columns.name: Facility Name
columns.description: Legal name of the licensed Home Services Placement Agency as recorded by IDPH. May include a "DBA" (doing business as) trade name where the agency operates under a name different from its legal entity name.

columns.name: Address
columns.description: Street address of the agency's licensed parent location. Suite or building numbers are included where applicable. Branch offices and drop-sites are not separately listed.

columns.name: City
columns.description: Municipality of the agency's licensed parent location.

columns.name: County
columns.description: Illinois county of the agency's licensed parent location. The agency's approved geographic service area may extend beyond this county; consult IDPH for service area details.

columns.name: Zip
columns.description: Five-digit U.S. Postal Service ZIP code of the agency's licensed parent location.

columns.name: Contact Name
columns.description: Primary administrative contact at the agency, designated for IDPH correspondence. Typically the agency manager or licensee.

columns.name: Phone
columns.description: Main published telephone number for the agency, including area code. Format: (XXX) XXX-XXXX.

columns.name: License Number
columns.description: License number issued by the Illinois Department of Public Health authorizing the agency to operate as a Home Services Placement Agency under 77 Ill. Adm. Code 245.214. Note: agencies of this type are also separately licensed by the Illinois Department of Labor as a Private Employment Agency; that license number is not included in this dataset.

columns.name: Exp. Date
columns.description: Date on which the agency's current IDPH license expires. Agencies must submit a renewal application prior to this date to maintain authority to operate. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
